observed_failure: On an actual-backend 64K Qwen3.5-9B-6bit managed UI run, the Agent issued 202 exact leading 'cd /workspace &&' shell commands. The nonexistent /workspace path caused 200 external_directory denials, 207 total tool errors, no controller checks, and an operator interruption after 969.285 seconds. fix_scope: In an Agent shell call with no explicit workdir, rewrite only a leading 'cd /workspace && ' prefix when /workspace does not exist. Native shell then starts in its existing project directory. Other paths, nonleading commands, explicit workdir calls and existing /workspace directories are unchanged. No agent loop, permission policy change or prompt rule was added.
